title: `EnsureClosure` would not add a vertex's closure if added in future
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  Assume there is a closureId which is supposed to include 3 vertexId , but for now only 2 of those are registered in the Token.sol . This is fine since when liquidity is added with `addLiq()` this is how it is done to ensure closure ->  ```solidity for (uint8 i = 0; i < n; ++i) {             VertexId v = newVertexId(i);             if (cid.contains(v)) {                 Vertex storage vert = Store.vertex(v);                 // We need to add it to the Vertex so we can use it in swaps.                 vert.ensureClosure(cid); ``
